subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6601deaa5b61f791f091cb629cec7b5d9c4be3f89d0b6b1f89d04c2a35ffcc27.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) First box series →

The 1st and 2nd column elements shift anticlockwise.

The 3rd and 4th column elements shift anticlockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d3f17b442b86e1f082d0745ad6cfe0d4c3df0443d6f1a9d24f97d504b7c0790.png] 

 

2) Second box series →

The 2nd row elements shift anticlockwise.

The left diagonal elements interchange positions.

The 3rd element from the left of the 2nd row is replaced by new element subsequently. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fbd67ac92f305fc2b70acd709bd32bd877b39939da767a8492308ffa72a7a188.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/422fe379f436c6c548a6ea60579bf5772ef222b30848f6ba34b7b5eab943aad5.png] 

Hence, "Option 1 is the correct answer.
